title: Bulk RNA sequencing of human C2 dorsal root ganglia tissue from fusion surgeries
note: Both arms are neck-pain patients undergoing C1-C2 arthrodesis; the contrast is chronic against acute pain, so the effect size it yields is not the pain-versus-control effect size the pool integrates. Four subjects (CC0009, CC0022, CC0026, CC0027) deposit both ganglia, so 17 samples come from 13 subjects and n inflates by four unless one side is taken per subject.

title: Single nucleus sequencing of human C2 dorsal root ganglia tissue from fusion surgeries
note: The single-nucleus arm of the same cohort as SPARC-478 and excluded for the same reason. Not assessed at file level.

title: Spatial transcriptomics of human C2 dorsal root ganglia tissue from fusion surgeries
note: The spatial arm of the same cohort as SPARC-478. Spatial is not a modality in this analysis; excluded on the contrast regardless.

title: Bulk proteomics of naive human dorsal root ganglion
note: Naive tissue from four male and four female organ donors. The only grouping variable is sex, so there is no pain arm. Kept on the record as a candidate human DRG reference proteome.
